definitions.explanation: A property for sale or rent, commonly used in real estate contexts.
A physical object or item, especially in legal or formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅近|えきちか}→駅近：08329_ekichika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{物件|ぶっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{物件|ぶっけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧{物件|ぶっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{内見|ないけん}する→内見：09717_naiken⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to view a rental property.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is what a learner meets first: in listings and agency talk, {物件|ぶっけん} is the unit of real estate on offer — one flat, one house, one shop.
- ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧{物件|ぶっけん} (rental property)
- ⟦{売買|ばいばい}→売買：04336_baibai⟧{物件|ぶっけん} (property for sale)
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧{物件|ぶっけん} (pre-owned property)
- ⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧{物件|ぶっけん} (newly built property)
- ⟦{優良|ゆうりょう}→優良：30330_yuuryou⟧{物件|ぶっけん} (quality property, good deal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物件|ぶっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to look for a property)
- {物件|ぶっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to view a property)
- {物件|ぶっけん}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (property listing information)

SENSE 2 — LEGAL AND POLICE USE:
Outside real estate, {物件|ぶっけん} is the formal word for a physical object treated as an item in a case or record: ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧{物件|ぶっけん} (item of evidence). It is not a general word for "thing" — for that, use ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧ - real estate as a category, including land; {物件|ぶっけん} is one listed unit of it
- ⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧ / ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ - the building types a listing may be for
- ⟦{一戸建|いっこだ}て→一戸建て：19687_ikkodate⟧ - detached house
